exposure: two-step antenatal glucose screening programme results
50-g glucose challenge test (GCT) results (between 130 and 140 mg/dl)
single-value abnormality (SVA) in 100-g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT)
cohort: The study included 2,402 pregnant women attending for antenatal care who were screened for gestational diabetes mellitus.
finding: Pregnant women with a single-value abnormality in 100-g OGTT or 50-g GCT results between 130 and 140 mg/dl had significantly higher mean birthweight and higher rates of macrosomia.
birth_weight: Mean birthweight of 3420 ± 378g for pregnancies with SVA and 3294 ± 444g for the control group.
